M3.1 Flash is live on @FireworksAI_HQ . Let’s talk about how it was built—over cocktails.  

Join MiniMax and @FireworksAI_HQ for Code & Cocktails in SF, where @Prof_OZ from Fireworks and @VictorSuOrtiz from MiniMax will discuss:  
→ What went into building M3.1 Flash for long-running agents 
→ How coding, tool use, and visual reasoning work together 
→ What cheaper cached tokens mean for the cost of agent loops  

Then drinks, bites, and time to compare notes with other builders.  
📅 Tuesday, November 10 · Doors at 6 PM, fireside at 6:45 PM 
📍 San Francisco · Venue shared after registration approval  

Bring your questions. Registration below.
